review.chain: DUB-17 Theorem 2.6 / DUB-18 Corollary 8.2 -> original all-weight arithmetic association -> actual Gamma1 Hecke-character realization -> Picard/H1 and Abel-Jacobi -> real period surjectivity -> matching Manin/genus cusp terms -> exact cusp widths.
review.assumptionsToDischarge: The actual rational cusp orbit space is finite and maps onto every j-pole place, by proved invariance and actual cusp exhaustion. Laurent reindexing gives raw j order minus N. The exact nonzero meromorphic uniformizer and translation invariance force N to divide the product of the signed stabilizer translation and the cusp ramification. Thus the algebraic j-pole order is at most every positive signed stabilizer translation. Finiteness, surjectivity, the raw pole order and this bound are derived, not assumed.
review.remaining: Identify the least positive signed stabilizer translation with its finite coset-orbit size; sum sizes to the subgroup index and compare with the j-pole degree to prove injectivity and exact widths. Reverse dimension, real period surjectivity, reciprocity, Picard/Hecke/diamond/H1, full all-weight characteristic-zero association and higher continuation remain. 16/20; DUB-17--20 OPEN.
